#### Article 18

1. Regional Government in implementing the responsibility for gender mainstreaming institutionalization as referred to - 12 - in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter b regarding Protection of Women and Children shall organize a data information system for Women and Children.
2. The Women's data Information System as referred to in paragraph (1) constitutes an inseparable part of the Children's data information system.
3. The Women's and Children's information system as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.
4. Gender mainstreaming as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be organized in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 19 (1) In order to ensure effectiveness of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children, Regional Government must conduct cross-sectoral coordination with related institutions.

2. In organizing the coordination of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) the Regent shall establish a coordination team for Protection of Women and Children.
3. In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2) the coordination team for Protection of Women and Children shall have the duties to: a. prepare necessary materials related to the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and b. deliver results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
4. The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

## Part Two

Prevention of Violence Against Women and Children

#### Article 20

1. Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement Prevention efforts against the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i conducted in the form of: a. collecting data and organizing an information system for Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence;  
b. conducting education on anti-Violence values against Women and Children; and  
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to women's empowerment and Protection of Children victims of Violence.
2. Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to provide and organize services for victims in the form of: a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving Community elements; and b. encouraging Community awareness of the importance of protection for victims of Violence.

## Part Three

Institutions

#### Article 21

1. Technical Service institutions as referred to in Article 20 paragraph (2) letter a shall be implemented by P2TP2A and FPK2PA.
2. In organizing Protection of Women and Children the Regional Government shall establish a regional technical implementing unit for Protection of Women and Children.
3. The establishment of regional technical implementing unit as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be stipulated by Regent Regulation after obtaining written approval from the Governor.
4. In the case of implementation of technical services as referred to in paragraph (1) the Regional Government may establish a task force. (5) The task force as referred to in paragraph (4) may also conduct institutional strengthening through cooperation and coordination with: a. KLA task force;  
b. KRA task force;  
c. K/DRA task force;  
d. schools and/or educational institutions;  
e. Children's forum;  
f. children's center;  
g. community organizations;  
h. women's organizations; and i. other institutions concerned with the fulfillment of rights and Protection of Children.
6. The task force as referred to in paragraph (4) constitutes a coordinative institution at regency and sub-district level that coordinates policies, programs and activities to realize sub-districts, child-friendly villages/wards.
7. Further provisions regarding technical services as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

### Paragraph 1

#### P2TP2A

Article 22 (1) The implementation of services to victims shall be conducted in an integrated manner by P2TP2A.

2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) may receive and send case referrals from or to other service units in the form of functional relationship patterns among components directed to achieve common goals.

#### Article 23

1. P2TP2A provides services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house.
2. In the event that P2TP2A does not yet have a safe house, then victims of Violence shall be referred to other integrated service centers that have a safe house.

#### Article 24

1. P2TP2A consists of several counseling fields.
2. The counseling fields as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:  a. law;  

b. health;  
c. spiritual; and d. psychology.
3. The implementation of counseling shall be conducted by counselors and may be implemented by involving related parties.

Article 25 Forms of services to victims organized by P2TP2A include:

a. medical services;  
b. medicolegal services;  
c. psychosocial services;  
d. legal services;  
e. social reintegration services; and f. economic independence services.

15 -

#### Article 26

Provisions regarding the implementation of services by P2TP2A as referred to in Article 22 paragraph (1) shall be regulated in Regent Regulation.

### Paragraph 2

#### FPK2PA

#### Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of Violence, FPK2PA shall be established.
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:  a. Regional FPK2PA;  
b. sub-district FPK2PA; and c. village/ward FPK2PA.
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a shall be stipulated by the Regent.
4. The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b shall be stipulated by the sub-district head.
5. The establishment of Village/ward FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be stipulated by the village/ward head. (6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER VI

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

## Part One

Obligations and Responsibilities of Parents and/or Family

#### Article 28

Parents have the obligation and responsibility to:

a. nurture, care for, educate, manage, and take care of the family;  
b. develop family members in accordance with their abilities, talents, and interests; and  
c. Prevention of marriage at Child age.

Article 29 Protecting family members in accordance with Increasing the role of families in Protection of Women and Children shall be conducted through:

a. Prevention of marriage at Child age;  
b. bringing Women closer to health services; and c. increasing family resilience.

## Part Two

Community Involvement Article 30 (1) The Community is involved in the Protection of Women and Children.  (2) Community involvement as referred to in paragraph (1) is in the form of participation through Prevention, services, empowerment, monitoring, supervision and fulfillment of the rights of Women and/or Children.  

3. The role of the Community in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by: a . providing communication and information through socialization and education regarding the rights of Women and Children;  
b. providing suggestions and input in the formulation of policies related to the Protection of Women and Children;  
c. reporting to the competent authorities if violations of the rights of Women and Children occur;  
d. playing an active role in the rehabilitation and social reintegration process for Women and Children;  
e. forming family partners at the neighborhood association/community association or sub-district/village level by the Community;  
f. forming Women and Children Protection units within community organizations and educational institutions;  
g. establishment and management of orphanages;  

h . establishment of Child rehabilitation centers;  
i. provision of shelter houses and/or social homes;  
j. job skills training; and k. providing first aid when violations of the rights of Women and Children occur.  
4. Further provisions regarding the participation of the Community shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER VII

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 31

1. The Regent is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children.  
2. The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.  

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;  
b. guidance;  
c. education and training;  
d. monitoring and evaluation;  
e. reporting.  
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with the norms, standards, procedures and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.  
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.  
6. In implementing guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection must report periodically to the Regent.  
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related organizational institutions.

# CHAPTER VIII

## EVALUATION

#### Article 32

1. Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children is conducted based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, Prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.  
2. The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.  
3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and results evaluation.  
4. The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Regional Apparatus to prepare a report which is subsequently submitted to the Regent.  
5. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.  

(6) Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.  

CHAPTER IX

##### REPORTING

#### Article 33

1. Reporting of evaluation results as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as material for the Regent's consideration in making policy decisions on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.  
2. Reports on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year and at any time if necessary.

# CHAPTER X

## FUNDING

Article 34 Funding for the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children is sourced from:
a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and b. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER XI

## CLOSING PROVISIONS

Article 35 The establishment of a regional technical implementing unit that administers the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in Article 21 paragraph (2) shall be implemented in accordance with the financial capacity of the Region.  

#### Article 36

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.  In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by its placement in the Regional Gazette of Gunung Mas Regency.

##### PENJELASAN

##### PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN GUNUNG MAS

##### NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2021

##### TENTANG

##### PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

##### I. UMUM

Anak adalah masa depan bangsa dan generasi penerus cita cita bangsa, sehingga setiap Anak berhak atas kelangsungan  hidup, tumbuh dan berkembang, berpartisipasi serta berhak atas  perlindungan dari tindak Kekerasan dan diskriminasi serta hak  sipil dan kebebasan.  

Demikian pula Perempuan yang berperan sebagai ibu yang  melahirkan anak-anak yang sehat, kuat, tangguh, berakhlak  mulia, potensial dan berkualitas. Melalui peranan Perempuan  dalam keluarga, Masyarakat dan negara akan lahir generasi genarasi tangguh yang akan melanjutkan cita-cita bangsa.  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun  1945 khususnya Pasal 27 ayat ( 1) yang menyatakan bahwa "Segala  warga negara bersamaan kedudukannya di dalam hukum dan  pemerintahan dan wajib menjunjung tinggi hukum dan  pemerintahan itu dengan tidak ada kecualinya". Walaupun  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945  telah menjamin persamaan kedudukan di setiap warga negara,  namun hingga saat ini Perempuan dan Anak masih mengalami  berbagai hambatan untuk memperoleh hak-haknya hampir  di segala bidang.  

Di sisi lain, Perempuan memiliki kebutuhan khusus  dibandingkan laki-laki, sehingga sesuai dengan kodratnya  tersebut, dalam kondisi tertentu Pemerintah Daerah harus dapat  menjamin haknya dipenuhi sesuai dengan kebutuhan tersebut.  Sedangkan anak, mereka adalah amanah dan karunia Tuhan Yang  Maha Esa, dimana dalam dirinya melekat harkat dan martabat  sebagai manusia seutuhnya. Mengingat posisi dan harapan kepada  anak sebagai potensi dan masa depan bangsa sehingga anak patut  mendapat perhatian dari semua pihak agar anak dapat tumbuh  dan berkembang secara wajar serta terhindar dari perlakuan dan  tindakan yang salah, Kekerasan, diskirminasi yang akan merusak  perkembangan anak baik fisik, mental maupun sosial anak. Untuk  itu anak perlu mendapatkan kesempatan seluas-luasnya untuk  dapat tumbuh dan berkembang secara optimal, baik secara fisik,  mental, sosial dan akhlak yang mulia.  

21 - Berpangkal tolak dari hal tersebut, diperlukan suatu  regulasi yang menjadi pedoman bagi semua pihak, khususnya  Pemerintah Daerah dalam menjamin terselenggaranya  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Gunung Mas  sesuai dengan kewenangan yang dimiliki yang tercantum dalam  Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan  Daerah, maupun peraturan perundang-undangan lain yang  mengatur tentang Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.

##### CONCERNING

##### PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

##### I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.
